summary: Stage evidence-backed review findings in chat until the user selects exactly what may become an external draft.

scenarios.title: Review without publishing
scenarios.prompt: Use the stage-code-review-findings skill to review my uncommitted changes. Keep every finding in Polish and in chat only.
scenarios.outcome: Actionable findings with stable IDs, tight line anchors, and no source edits, browser drafts, or provider mutations.

scenarios.title: Publish selected findings only
scenarios.prompt: Accept F1 and F3 from the staged review and prepare them for the named pull request. Leave every other finding unpublished.
scenarios.outcome: Only the accepted findings advance in concise reviewer-facing English after their anchors are revalidated.
